mentions.name: Space Deck X
mentions.description: A work-in-progress video game that combines a shoot-em-up with deck building: the player flies and shoots through enemies until reaching a boss, then fights the boss using a card deck. Built with the Kaplay game dev library; planned work includes reworking enemy wave spawning, adding a short tutorial, two more bosses, and more enemies. A playable in-progress build is hosted on itch.io.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a video game, purely for fun.

Here is a work in progress build:

https://muffinman-io.itch.io/space-deck-x

It is a combination of a shoot-em-up and deck building. You fly and shoot until you get to the boss, when you get your deck out to fight them.
